### Overview
**DonorDock** and **Bloomerang** are both nonprofit CRMs focused on donor management, but DonorDock emphasizes an all-in-one platform with AI tools and unlimited contacts at a flat price, while Bloomerang prioritizes retention analytics and offers modular add-ons with pricing that scales by contacts.[1][2][4]

### Key Feature Comparison
| Category              | Bloomerang                                                                 | DonorDock                                                                 |
|-----------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Core Focus**       | Retention scores, engagement metrics, donor analytics[1][4]                | Action Board for daily tasks, Smart Nudges, AI assistant (Otto) for personalized comms and insights[1] |
| **Included Tools**   | CRM base; extra fees for email ($125+/mo), fundraising ($40+/mo), volunteers ($119+/mo)[1] | CRM, email/text marketing, online giving, project mgmt, AI—all in one plan[1][2] |
| **Contacts/Users**   | Pricing scales with contact volume; unlimited users[1][2]                  | Unlimited contacts and users on every plan[1][2]                          |
| **AI/Integrations**  | Penny AI for analytics[1]                                                  | Otto AI deeply integrated with workflows; custom fields, integrations[1]  |
| **Other**            | Wealth screening, nightly address verification, volunteer mgmt add-on[2][6]| Task mgmt (Action/Ask Boards), custom reporting, SOC 2 Type II[1]         |

DonorDock bundles features without add-ons, making it more predictable for growing nonprofits, while Bloomerang requires piecing together modules.[1][2]

### Pricing
- **DonorDock**: Single "ONE" plan at ~$98/month (plus transaction fees); no contracts, unlimited everything, no setup fee.[1][2][3]
- **Bloomerang**: Starts at $125/month for CRM; scales with contacts; add-ons extra (e.g., $40+/month fundraising); 1%+ platform fees.[1][2][3]
DonorDock keeps costs flat as donor base grows, unlike Bloomerang's volume-based scaling.[1]

### User Reviews and Ratings
- **TrustRadius (2026)**: DonorDock scores higher in Fundraising/Events (9.1 vs. 7.0); both 9.5/10 for small businesses. DonorDock praised as "powerful tool" for budget-challenged orgs.[2]
- **G2**: Bloomerang has higher overall satisfaction; users like its data analysis and ease. DonorDock lauded as "one-stop shop" for donations/email/memberships, but some note reporting limits.[4]
- **Capterra**: Mixed; Bloomerang users love integrations (e.g., DonorSearch) and value; one calls DonorDock "amazing product for reasonable price." Complaints on Bloomerang include billing and UI.[5]
Reviewers note DonorDock's ease for small/medium nonprofits, while Bloomerang excels in analytics depth.[4][5]

### Strengths and Limitations
- **Choose DonorDock** if you want affordable, actionable AI/tools without scaling costs or add-ons—ideal for small teams needing daily workflows.[1][2]
- **Choose Bloomerang** for strong retention analytics, volunteer mgmt, and proven donor engagement scoring, despite higher/modular pricing.[1][4][8]
Third-party sites (e.g., Zeffy) highlight both have fees unlike free alternatives, but DonorDock appears more cost-effective for basics.[3] Data from DonorDock's site is promotional, so cross-check reviews for balance.[1][4]
